checks.name: chat_blocks_check
checks.expr: ((visitor_id IS NOT NULL) OR (ip_hash IS NOT NULL))

indexes.name: conversations_queue_waiting
indexes.where: ((queue_id IS NOT NULL) AND (assignee_user_id IS NULL) AND (status = ANY (ARRAY['open'::text, 'pending'::text])))

indexes.name: conversations_ring_group
indexes.where: ((ring_group_id IS NOT NULL) AND (assignee_user_id IS NULL))

checks.name: devices_ha1_present
checks.expr: ((auth_mode = 'derived'::text) OR ((ha1_md5 IS NOT NULL) AND (ha1_sha256 IS NOT NULL)))

checks.name: locations_check2
checks.expr: ((radius_m IS NULL) OR (latitude IS NOT NULL))

checks.name: oauth_clients_check
checks.expr: ((kind <> 'service'::text) OR ((role IS NOT NULL) AND (scopes IS NOT NULL)))

indexes.name: scim_resources_external
indexes.where: ((external_id IS NOT NULL) AND (deleted_at IS NULL))

functions.name: scep_revoke_removed_phone
